description: Calibration signals for the muted-ear isolation measurement (tests/cpp/isolation.hpp). Mode bin: active channel a unit-amplitude unmodulated sine at carrier_hz. Mode band: active channel a unit-amplitude sine whose frequency follows carrier_hz + swing_hz * sin(2 pi t / period_s + start_phase_deg), spanning band_lo_hz to band_hi_hz. Muted channel: the same signal at level_db relative to it, phase offset phase_offset_rad.
